sources.title: OpenAI Structured Outputs
sources.designImplication: Schema-conforming output tetap dapat salah. Pisahkan syntax, meaning dan task evaluation.

sources.title: OWASP LLM Prompt Injection Prevention
sources.designImplication: Untrusted text dan excessive agency memerlukan pertahanan berlapis; system prompt bukan authorization.

sources.title: MCP specification
sources.designImplication: Halaman latest redirect ke 2026-07-28 pada pemeriksaan ini. Pin/negotiate supported protocol; route protokol bukan reasoning model.

sources.title: W3C Reflow
sources.designImplication: Ada pengecualian terbatas untuk bagian yang membutuhkan layout dua dimensi; bukan semua mobile menjadi cards.

sources.title: W3C WAI-ARIA patterns
sources.designImplication: Referensi behavior kontrol dan navigasi; mengikuti pattern tidak otomatis membuktikan full accessibility.

sources.title: Lit SSR
sources.designImplication: Lit SSR merupakan Labs experimental; production feasibility gate memeriksa integration dan limitations nyata.

sources.title: Web Vitals
sources.designImplication: Whole-page field metrics berbeda dari library microbenchmark. Ukur keduanya dengan scope yang benar.

sources.title: Playwright snapshots
sources.designImplication: Visual baselines bergantung environment. Pin font/browser/OS/DPR dan review perbedaan.

sources.title: npm unpublish policy
sources.designImplication: Published name+version tidak bisa digunakan ulang setelah unpublish. Hapus bukan cara reset namespace history.

sources.title: npm dist-tag
sources.designImplication: Default install mengikuti latest tag. Promotion reset 0.1.0 harus disengaja, tidak implied semver upgrade.

sources.title: Semantic Versioning
sources.designImplication: Urutan versi numerik tetap berlaku; product reset tidak membuat 0.1.0 lebih tinggi dari 0.2.0.

sources.title: OpenAPI specification
sources.designImplication: HTTP schema/operation description membantu tooling; tidak mengimplementasikan query atau business semantics.

sources.title: Standard Schema
sources.designImplication: Validation interoperability dibedakan dari JSON Schema/introspection. Importer perlu capability yang sesuai.

sources.title: Chrome WebMCP imperative API
sources.designImplication: Dokumen memakai document.modelContext dan lifecycle registration/cancel. Support native harus diuji; masih berubah.

sources.title: Substrait specification
sources.designImplication: Prior art logical relational plans terpisah engine. Tidak mewajibkan Aeliqo mengadopsi seluruh format.

sources.title: PostgreSQL transaction isolation
sources.designImplication: Snapshot/isolation ditentukan backend. Multiquery Task tidak membuat snapshot global sendiri.

sources.title: Draco research
sources.designImplication: Hard/soft constraints untuk visualization design merupakan prior art, bukan jaminan optimal UX.

sources.title: Vega-Lite composition
sources.designImplication: Layer/facet/concat/repeat mendukung composability. Domain sharing perlu kesesuaian semantic.

sources.title: Lit React integration
sources.designImplication: React binding dapat membungkus shared web elements. Tetap uji properties/events/lifecycle/SSR.

sources.title: Optimize long tasks
sources.designImplication: Yield/break long work supaya input responsif; worker bukan default untuk operasi kecil.

sources.title: PostgreSQL row security
sources.designImplication: Host enforcement permission berbeda dari frontend filter. Gunakan existing app authority.

sources.title: Apache License 2.0
sources.designImplication: Sumber lisensi public kit; business packaging/trademark/contracts perlu review terpisah.

sources.title: A2UI overview
sources.designImplication: Agent-to-UI declarative architecture memiliki prior art. Aeliqo membuktikan owned semantics/query/adaptive task value, bukan klaim tanpa kompetitor.

sources.title: Tambo
sources.designImplication: Registered-component agent UI sudah ada. Perbandingan adoption/meaning/query/performance harus berbasis equivalent task.

sources.title: OpenAI subagents
sources.designImplication: Model/effort dan delegation tersedia menurut client. Pilihan pengguna Astra Medium/Luna Max tetap perlu actual local verification.

sources.title: OpenAI configuration reference
sources.designImplication: Config keys bergantung versi. Generator tidak membuktikan konfigurasi efektif session; jangan copy key yang belum diverifikasi.

sources.title: OpenAI AGENTS.md
sources.designImplication: Instruction discovery hierarchical; gunakan root index singkat dan task docs progresif, bukan master penuh per agent.

sources.title: OpenAI harness engineering
sources.designImplication: Repository knowledge dan mechanical boundaries mendukung workflow agent. Tidak menggantikan actual tests dan review.

sources.title: Node release schedule
sources.designImplication: Gunakan supported LTS yang dipin dan diuji, bukan dependency patch yang diarang pada kit.

sources.title: DTCG format
sources.designImplication: Token interchange community specification; Aeliqo Experience Profile bukan W3C Recommendation.
